Title: Jyhad master skill question / Chantry question

Messages.Author: Ian
Messages.Body:
Questions on Jyhad.
1) Can I play a master skill card on ANY vvampire, including another methusala's?
   What abouut one in torpor? Uncontrolled?

2) is the effect of the chantry mandatory?  does it apply to all tremere in torpor, or
just mine?  

3) does trap mean for 3 rounds after the last card was played, or 3 rounds and no one 
can play cards?

4) are there any jyhad expansions planned?

Thanks.
Ian WArford.

Messages.Author: Tom Wylie
Messages.Body:
Ian <iwarford@undergrad.math.uwaterloo.ca> wrote:
>1) Can I play a master skill card on ANY vvampire, including another
>	methusalah's?  What about one in torpor?

Skill cards can be played on any controlled vampire, even ones in torpor
or under someone else's control.  Cards can never be played on uncontrolled
vampires unless the card says so.

>2) is the effect of the chantry mandatory?  does it apply to all tremere in
>torpor, or just mine?  

Am pretty sure it's optional, but will double check that.  You could revive
someone else's Tremere if you wanted to.

>3) does trap mean for 3 rounds after the last card was played, or 3 rounds
>and no one can play cards?

3 rounds after the last card played.

>4) are there any jyhad expansions planned?

Yes, but no details have been announced.
